summary: A compact rectangular structure with a stepped pyramid roof design. The building features a stone brick and wood construction with decorative gold block corner accents. It has a central entrance on the front face and sits on a dirt foundation surrounded by grass.

shape.overall_form: rectangular box with stepped pyramid roof

rebuild_hints: Build rectangular base approximately 8×12 blocks using stone brick
Add wood trim band horizontally around mid-height of walls
Place gold blocks at all four corners as decorative pillars
Construct stepped pyramid roof using stone slabs, stepping inward with each layer
Create central entrance opening on front face at ground level
Ensure symmetry along the length axis
Surround structure with dirt platform foundation
Top roof section appears to be a single block or small platform
uncertainties: Exact interior layout and depth of entrance unclear from angles shown
Precise number of roof steps difficult to count; appears to be 3-4 layers
Whether structure is hollow or solid interior unknown
Exact dimensions uncertain; estimates based on visible block proportions
